rules.match: ^data_E22\.tar\.gz:(?P<member>[A-Za-z0-9]+/gbar_gobs_[A-Za-z0-9]+\.fits):row (?P<row>\d+), (?P<column>GOBS); the source computed g: non-parametric hydrostatic reconstruction evaluated at the radii of the data \(E22 §3\.4, l\. 263\); g_obs = G M_HSE\(<r\)/r² \(l\. 453\)$

rules.match: ^data_E22\.tar\.gz:(?P<member>[A-Za-z0-9]+/gbar_gobs_[A-Za-z0-9]+\.fits):row (?P<row>\d+), (?P<column>GBAR); the source computed g, including the central galaxy's dynamical mass-to-light ratio: G \(M_gas \+ M★,BCG \+ M★,sat\)\(<r\)/r² \(E22 l\. 456\); ICL excluded \(l\. 410\)$
